# Offers

> A private dashboard that tracks which credit card credits and offers are used or unused in each period, from bank transactions in Actual Budget.

## Pages

- [Tracker](https://offers.sudhanva.me/): each card, its offers as rows, and the last six months as columns
- [Cards](https://offers.sudhanva.me/cards): fee years, earning rates, and credits that no offer explains
- [AI log](https://offers.sudhanva.me/review): low-confidence AI decisions

## API

- [GET /api/tracker](https://offers.sudhanva.me/api/tracker): the tracker grid as JSON
- [GET /api/review](https://offers.sudhanva.me/api/review): the AI log as JSON
